blocks.text: Arteries woh naliyan hain jo khoon ko dil se door, jism ke mukhtalif hisson tak le jati hain. Pulmonary arteries ke siwa tamam arteries oxygenated khoon le jati hain. Artery ke beech ki khali jagah lumen kehlati hai. Artery ki deewar teen tahon (layers) se bani hai. Bahar wali tah tunica externa ya adventitia hai, jo connective aur elastic (lachakdar) tissue se bani hai. Darmiyani tah tunica media hai, jo moti muscular tissue (pathon) aur elastic fibres se bani hai. Andar wali tah tunica intima hai, jo endothelial cells ki patli tah hai. Darmiyani tah sab se ahem hai, kyun ke yeh ventricular systole ke waqt khoon ke zyada dabao (pressure) ko bardasht karti hai. Arteries bat kar chhoti naliyan banati hain jinhen arterioles kehte hain. Arterioles baar baar batti hain aur aakhir mein bohat bareek shakhon ka ghana jaal (network) banati hain; inhen capillaries kehte hain.

blocks.alt: Kati hui artery seedhi-dar belanon (cylinders) ki shakal mein: beech mein lumen, jis par tunica intima (endothelium) ki tah hai; is ke gird smooth muscles aur elastic tissue wala tunica media; aur sab se bahar mota tunica externa, jis se arterioles nikalti hain.
